description: Side & Rear Ground and First Floor extensions, including a new dormer extention to the rear to replace the existing dormer extension. Installation of new metal-framed glazed doors and windows on the rear and side elevation. Installation of double glazed timber casement windows to existing openings to the front of the property. Installation of new aluminium-framed double-glazed roof lights over the new ground floor extension to the rear and to the front of the property in the loft space.
